reason: Rank low-risk edits to the supplied assembly first: scratch_lifetime changes stack reservation, and the counter-width and independent-tile issue-order proposals preserve each tile’s full K reduction. Their performance benefit is unverified and may be small. b_panel_layout is a distinct traversal and packing change, but adds timed packing and pointer complexity. transpose_fusion has higher implementation and correctness risk and repeats A loads and transposes across column panels. panel_packing and cache_blocking describe the same N=64 helper experiment; that helper is not supplied, so both require host preparation and should not be treated as separate experiments. No measured result establishes a gain for any proposal.
